articles.title: This lightweight Asus mouse could last the entire school year
articles.description: Back To School Get through the school year on a single charge Shop the Asus ProArt MD301 wireless mouse Buy Now Having the right mouse for work and school can make just as much of difference as having the best gaming mouse for gaming. If you’re on the hunt for a new mouse for when you head back to school after the Summer, or want to kit out a home office with something long-lasting, lightweight, and comfortable, the Asus ProArt MD301 is well worth considering. Working just as hard as you When you’re really putting in the hours, you don’t want any of your hardware to slow you down. A fast computer, a comfortable headset, and a supportive ergonomic mouse can complete the set and ensure you can get everything done that you need, with no interruptions. The Asus ProArt MD301 is a comfortable ergonomic design built to work with you as long as you can stick it out. Its supportive shape means you won’t encounter any wrist ache or repetitive strain, and it supports all major grip types, so no matter how you hold the mouse, it’ll feel comfortable to you. Its lightweight design weighs in at just 100g, despite its sturdy shell and array of ergonomically-placed buttons. That helps reduce fatigue over long work sessions, and makes the mouse more responsive for fine control. The soft plastic shell and silver accents give it a premium, refined look, too. Where a lot of wireless mice only last a few hours on a single charge, requiring frequent plug-ins, the MD301 is designed for extreme longevity. On a single full charge, this mouse will run for over 180 days without interruption. Better yet, plug it in for just one minute, and you’ll have eight hours of continued usage banked and ready to go. Asus What a student needs, and nothing more There’s no denying that most PC components, laptops, and desktops are very expensive in 2026, so finding a mouse that fits within a strict budget is important. The Asus ProArt MD301 is a mouse designed for work more than play, and though its comfort and accuracy are great for gaming in the downtime, there’s no extras tacked on here that are inflating the price tag. There’s no RGB lighting, no fans for cooling your gaming fingers: Just a high-quality sensor, comfortable ergonomic shell, and a long-lasting battery. Where most wireless mice only last for a few 10s of hours per charge, the MD301 goes way past that. On a full charge you can enjoy as much as 180 days before it needs a recharge. This is the kind of wireless mouse that you forget needs recharging, it’s so infrequent. The switches are rated for up to 80 million clicks, too, so this is one mouse that will stand the test of time. However, if you ever run into an issue, you can just switch them out for some replacements, helping this mouse to really last and avoid unnecessary e-waste. The 8,000 DPI sensor and 1,000Hz polling rate are plenty for everyday use, and it works over 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth, so you can connect it to just about anything – and up to five devices at once. The infinite scroll-wheel is really useful for running through long documents and web-pages, too; Great for long research sessions. Available now, the Asus ProArt MD301 has a U.S. price of $99.99. If you’re after a mouse to help get you through next-year’s projects and homework – and you might not even need to recharge it through the year – it’s well worth considering.
